top_signals.title: Stocks Churn as Oil Advance Boosts Treasury Yields
top_signals.summary:
A rally in oil prices left stocks wavering while bond yields rose, with trader anxiety building just days ahead of key inflation reports.
Aaron Kennon, Co-Founder & CEO of Clear Harbor Asset Management, discusses his view on the markets and takeaways from this earnings season. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rise 3% as Iran Demands US Cooperation
top_signals.summary: Oil prices jumped 3% on Monday after Iran said the U.S. must lift sanctions on Tehran, pay reparations and meet a number of other conditions before the Strait of Hormuz is reopened.Brent crude futures were up $2.48, or 3%, at $86.03 a barrel by 10:44 a.m. EDT (1444 GMT). U.S.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Europe Gas Prices Surge as Hormuz Deal Prospects Remain Murky
top_signals.summary: European natural gas prices jumped as discussions between Iran and Oman to reopen the Strait of Hormuz failed to convince traders that a deal would lead to a quick resumption of global LNG flows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BlackRock launches two Canada ETFs, with one allocating 3% to Bitcoin
top_signals.summary: BlackRock Canada’s new IBQT fund combines global equity exposure with a 3% Bitcoin allocation through the firm’s Canadian iShares Bitcoin ETF.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.summary:

top_signals.title: US not disengaging from Asia, seeks ‘partners, not protectorates,’ says Pentagon official
top_signals.summary: Undersecretary of Defense for Policy Elbridge Colby reaffirmed the U.S. interest in the region as he called for greater burden-sharing and partnership.
